title: Protect trade secrets and confidential know-how
summary: When valuable confidential technical or commercial information requires a deliberate protection plan. An owned confidential-information register with practical access, sharing and departure controls.
outcomes: An owned confidential-information register with practical access, sharing and departure controls.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When valuable confidential technical or commercial information requires a deliberate protection plan.

parts.title: Identify the information and business value
parts.guidance: Inventory the know-how, code, datasets, formulas, pricing or operating information to protect and who currently holds it. Distinguish public information, third-party confidential material and company-created information.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Choose the protection and sharing rules
parts.guidance: Counsel and business owners review ownership, confidentiality commitments and alternatives such as patenting or publication. Define permitted recipients and handling controls for each category without assuming a label alone establishes protection.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Choose the protection and sharing rules

parts.title: Implement approved access and storage controls
parts.guidance: Authorized administrators restrict repositories, document stores and export paths to approved roles. Verify logging and recovery arrangements and keep secrets out of public tickets and general onboarding materials.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the reviewed account operation described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Implement approved access and storage controls

parts.title: Review disclosures and train recipients
parts.guidance: Before sharing, verify the purpose, recipient authority and any required agreement. Explain handling and reporting expectations to staff and counterparties and retain evidence of approved disclosures.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Review access changes and suspected exposure
parts.guidance: Reconcile departures, role changes and external sharing with the register. Route suspected misuse to counsel and incident response, preserve evidence and reassess controls without making unsupported accusations.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: An owned confidential-information register with practical access, sharing and departure controls.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.
